models.official_lgbm: A: balanced LightGBM on Morgan+RDKit, official A4 labels only
models.pool_lgbm: B: A plus the unlabelled primary non-hits as pseudo-negatives
models.gate_x_tdi: C: P(log2fc < -1) from a calibrated LightGBM log2fc regressor x A
models.chemeleon_lr: D: balanced logistic regression on standardized CheMeleon, official labels
models.submitted_equal7: E: comparator, frozen complete-pool equal-seven OOF (umap only)
models.rank_mean_equal7_official: Equal percentile-rank mean of E and A
models.rank_mean_equal7_chemeleon: Equal percentile-rank mean of E and D
models.equal7_filter_0.1: E percentile rank, molecules with p_active < 0.1 pushed below all others
models.equal7_filter_0.2: E percentile rank, molecules with p_active < 0.2 pushed below all others
models.equal7_filter_0.3: E percentile rank, molecules with p_active < 0.3 pushed below all others

config.rate_selection: Pooled official-label MCC on the other outer folds; ties go to the lower rate
config.status: Validation-design probe; no candidate, submission or upload

gate_choice: LightGBM regressor on CYP3A4 primary log2fc (all screened training molecules), Platt-calibrated to P(log2fc < gate_threshold) on inner group-fold OOF predictions
caveats: The equal-seven comparator exists on umap folds only; scaffold comparisons use official_lgbm as the reference instead
Only 161 unlabelled screened non-hits exist for A4, so model B barely differs from model A by construction
Blind rank-based calls say nothing about the blind scored-label mask
Two historical A4 transitions are few and share one hidden test set
